title: Acid–base titration
basic_overview: Titration combines stoichiometric neutralisation with equilibrium/pH behaviour near and after equivalence.

extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Balance reaction. 2. Calculate moles. 3. Find excess/limiting species. 4. Apply equilibrium at equivalence if weak. 5. Select indicator from steep region.
extra_info_content.factors: Weak acid/strong base equivalence is basic; strong acid/weak base is acidic.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
